lines.text: WARO-BECK SYSTEMS LTO
DESCRIPTION
5-101 AMPLIFIER SERIES
The operation of both amplifier sections is identical. Only
one section will be described.
Each section consists of two ndi vi dua inverting' amplifiers,
namely Zl and Z2. These are followed by their respective out-
put stages Q1 through Q4.
In the 5-101, the two amplifier inputs are interconnected to
provide
cross coupled differential pair resulting in
balanced 6,000 ohm input. The output is actively balanced
The 5-101A is designed with the Z2 section to be used as
summing (mixing) input. The output of this section at termina
E4 is externally connected to E1, thus providing an unbalanced
input and an actively balanced output.
The 5-1018 presents an unbalanced bridging input (15k ohms) to
the source. As is the case with the 5-101A, the output at
terminal E4 is externally connected to E1 and is actively
balanced.
R47 to R50 together with C15 and C16 provide on-card power
supply decoup1ing.
